initial_query: I am looking for an existing residential dwelling. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 140 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better. I prefer properties near public transport.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing residential dwelling. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 140 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better. I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport. Per the 'near' proximity rule, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. The area (140 sqm minimum), capacity (18 people) and public transport preferences are not among the available energy columns and are not filtered here.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 140 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area >= 140 is applied. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to public transport have no reference columns and are excluded. The location (Turin) is a geographic request handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not populated from the city name.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 140 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the extracted requirements that map to allowlisted columns: surface_area >= 140, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). The property-type requirement is omitted because tipologia_bene_immobile is not in filterable_columns (property_type is the filterable equivalent but was not requested as such). Capacity for 18 people and the Turin place name are not translated into predicates, since no agent supplied a column for them. Results are ordered by distance from the center point.
